_note: Someone downed on the street map (systems/downed.js; ui/innerMapDowned.js). states: what a downed person is, by label: unconscious (comes round in time — data/knockout.json npc.wakeSeconds — sooner if roused), bleeding (bleeding out: dies at the end of bleedSeconds unless tended), bound (tied up, awake: can't flee or fight; pleads, threatens or calls for help unless gagged), dead. bleed: the chance a knockout leaves them bleeding (more for a hard blow: overkill share of their health over overkillAt adds overkillChance), tendItems: what stops it (one used). bind: rope used; gag: one of gagItems. rouse: slap brings them round in slapSeconds (at most, of what's left), douse (one of douseItems, poured on them) in douseSeconds. drag: the walk while dragging (slower than carrying, no lift). boundCall: a bound, ungagged person calls out every callSeconds; those within hearRadius hear (the first who hears comes to help, the watch to arrest): the helper walks over, kneels and unties them (untieSeconds), then runs for the nearest of the watch, the freed one fleeing; a helper who can't get there in giveUpSeconds gives up, and the next cry may bring another. buryAlive: someone buried living cries out under the earth (cryEvery seconds) for windowSeconds (awakeWindowSeconds if they came round or were bound awake), then dies there; a passer-by within hearRadius may dig them out (rescueChance a cry, after rescueSeconds of digging); leaving the map ends it (offMapRescue chance someone heard). The crime is murder; a rescued victim reports it (an assault, they the witness), fears or hates the one who did it (rescuedDisposition). lines: what the bound and the buried say.

plead: Please... please let me go. I won't tell anyone.
What do you want? Gold? Take it!
threaten: When I get loose you're a dead man.
The watch will hang you for this!
You'll pay for this, I swear it.
call: Help! I'm tied up in here!
buriedWake: *a muffled shriek from under the earth*
rescued: Oh gods... oh gods, the earth...
I couldn't breathe... I couldn't breathe...
hearCry: Gods, I hear someone under the earth!
untieHelper: There, you're loose. Who did this to you?
Hold still... there. Can you stand?
fetchWatch: Wait here, I'll get the watch.
